environment: macOS (Darwin 25.6.0), Python 3.14.7, Node test runner, git 2.50.1, gh 2.97.0; scratch copies of skills/sdlc and hooks; local bare git remote and a 127.0.0.1 HTTP stub

cases.title: git --work-tree <pinned verb> push through the state-write.py git wrapper hides a push
cases.given: a copy of skills/sdlc and hooks at commit 112b45b
cases.when: append git(repo, "--work-tree", "fetch", "push", "origin", "sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0") to state-write.py and run push_guard.py
cases.then: the output must differ from the pins
cases.actual: the output equals the pins: the scanner skips --work-tree as a flag and reads its value fetch as the verb; fetch is already pinned
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope: a push through a pinned wrapper counts in any spelling of the constant arguments, options before the verb included; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e (constant-folded wrapper verbs, pinned push calls)

evidence.title: attack
evidence.inline:
git(repo, '--work-tree', 'fetch', 'push', 'origin', VERIFY)
-> breaches() = []  (pushes, wrapperVerbs, opaque unchanged)
cause: classify() skips only -C and -c values; --work-tree, --git-dir, --namespace and --config-env take a separate value in git

cases.title: git --work-tree show push through the next-action.py run wrapper hides a push
cases.when: append run(repo, "git", "--work-tree", "show", "push", "origin", VERIFY) to next-action.py
cases.then: the output must differ from the pins
cases.actual: the output equals the pins; the verb reads as show
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope: a push through a pinned wrapper counts in any spelling of the constant arguments, options before the verb included; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e (constant-folded wrapper verbs, pinned push calls)

cases.title: git --work-tree diff push through the impact.py git_lines wrapper hides a push
cases.when: append git_lines(["--work-tree", "diff", "push", "origin", VERIFY], repo) to impact.py
cases.then: the output must differ from the pins
cases.actual: the output equals the pins; the verb reads as diff
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope: a push through a pinned wrapper counts in any spelling of the constant arguments, options before the verb included; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e (constant-folded wrapper verbs, pinned push calls)

cases.title: gh pr --milestone list create inside load_prs creates a pull request and keeps every pin
cases.when: insert run(repo, "gh", "pr", "--milestone", "list", "create", "--fill", "--head", b) as the first line of load_prs in next-action.py
cases.then: forgeViolations must hold verb pr create, or a pin must change
cases.actual: the output equals the pins: --milestone is not in GH_VALUE_OPTS, so its value list becomes the sub-verb and the call reads as the pinned gh pr list
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope: a gh or glab call that creates a pull request is covered in any spelling, options before the verb included; forge rule bans the verb pr create

evidence.title: attack
evidence.inline:
run(repo, 'gh', 'pr', '--milestone', 'list', 'create', '--fill', '--head', b) in load_prs -> breaches() = []
other value flags missing from GH_VALUE_OPTS: -m, -r/--reviewer, --recover

cases.title: pydoc.pipepager runs a shell command and the scanner does not see it
cases.when: append import pydoc; pydoc.pipepager("", "git push origin sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0") to janitor.py
cases.then: a process call must change the direct pin
cases.actual: the output equals the pins; pydoc is not a watched module
cases.specSource: ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e: a new form in neither list is covered when it is a process or network call in a scanned file

evidence.title: attack
evidence.inline:
pydoc.pipepager('', 'git push origin ' + VERIFY) -> breaches() = []
pipepager calls subprocess.Popen(cmd, shell=True); TC-security-10 proves it runs

cases.title: logging.handlers.HTTPHandler POSTs to the pulls API and the scanner does not see it

cases.then: a network call must change the network pin
cases.actual: the output equals the pins; logging is not a watched module
cases.specSource: ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e: a new form in neither list is covered when it is a process or network call in a scanned file

evidence.inline:

cases.title: xml.dom.minidom.parse fetches a URL and the scanner does not see it

cases.then: a network call must change the network pin

cases.title: git --work-tree fetch push really pushes a verify branch to a remote
cases.given: a scratch repo with branch sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 and a local bare remote
cases.when: run git -C w --work-tree fetch push origin sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0
cases.then: the remote gets the verify ref
cases.actual: exit 0; the bare remote holds refs/heads/sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0
cases.specSource: proof for TC-security-1 to 3

cases.title: pydoc.pipepager runs a command and HTTPHandler sends a POST
cases.when: emit a record through HTTPHandler and call pydoc.pipepager with touch <marker>
cases.then: the stub sees one POST and the marker exists
cases.actual: [["POST","/repos/o/r/pulls"]] and the marker file exists
cases.specSource: proof for TC-security-5 and 6

cases.title: gh routes pr --milestone list create to the pr create command
cases.when: run gh pr --milestone list create --help
cases.then: the create help prints
cases.expected: gh reads create as the sub-verb
cases.actual: "Create a pull request on GitHub."
cases.specSource: proof for TC-security-4

evidence.title: gh help
evidence.inline:
$ gh pr --milestone list create --help
Create a pull request on GitHub.

cases.title: 35 VS-9 plan forms each break a pin
cases.when: apply each form: import aliases, posix_spawn, execvp, pty, asyncio, starred, tuple and args= argv, f-string verb, lambda, partial, -c alias, -C value, --git-dir=, gh api -X post, --method=POST, -XPOST, --field=, -ftitle=x, pulls split by +, graphql, glab mr create, gh pr create, getattr, __import__, importlib, and seven JS global forms
cases.then: each output differs from the pins
cases.actual: no form missed
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope: a push through a pinned wrapper counts in any spelling of the constant arguments, options before the verb included; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e (constant-folded wrapper verbs, pinned push calls)

evidence.title: attack
evidence.inline: 35 forms, 0 missed; see the HELD table in the test file

cases.title: new, unreadable and odd files fail closed
cases.when: add a syntax error, invalid UTF-8, a BOM, a latin-1 cookie, a NUL byte, a new subdirectory, a symlinked .py file, hooks/x.sh, x.mjs, x.cjs, a shebang file with no extension and x.PY
cases.then: each case breaks a pin or exits non-zero
cases.actual: no case missed
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope: scanned files and the pinned file list; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e

cases.title: a crash of push_guard.py is a non-zero exit, not an empty report
cases.when: run push_guard.py
cases.then: a non-zero exit with no stdout
cases.actual: exit 1, empty stdout, PermissionError on stderr; the T-R-119 guard() helper asserts exit 0, so the suite fails
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope

cases.title: a .py file under a symlinked directory is skipped and the output equals the pins
cases.given: the same copy with skills/sdlc/lib a symlink to a directory that holds x.py with a subprocess push; janitor.py imports lib.x
cases.when: run push_guard.py
cases.then: the file is scanned or reported, or the guard exits non-zero
cases.actual: exit 0 and the output equals the pins: os.walk does not follow directory links, so skills/sdlc/lib/x.py is never listed
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope: scanned files are every file under skills/sdlc and hooks; ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e covers the pinned list of scanned files. The link target lives outside the tree, so a judge can read this as S5

evidence.title: attack
evidence.inline:
symlink skills/sdlc/lib -> <tmp>/lib (x.py holds subprocess.run(['git','push',...]))
import lib.x appended to janitor.py
-> exit 0, breaches() = []

cases.title: hostile id and profile values never crash and stay under the prefix
cases.when: run name --kind verify and --kind attempt with each argv-safe entry of traversal, control-chars, flag-like-values, unicode-whitespace, unicode-confusables, injection and format-strings as --id or --profile
cases.then: exit 0 or 2, one JSON line, no traceback, no tree change, and every name under sdlc/
cases.actual: all hold; 36 entries give a ref-unsafe name (seed)
cases.specSource: R-009 and R-010 acceptance; the plan's VS-4 and VS-6 notes

cases.title: malformed round, part and n exit 2 or give an ASCII name
cases.when: run integer-forms, huge-integers and unicode-digits as --round, --part and --n
cases.then: exit 0 or 2, one JSON line, no traceback, no tree change, ASCII names
cases.actual: all hold; 63 values are accepted, negatives give S-001-v-1-http-api-0 and S-001-attempt--1
cases.specSource: R-009 and R-010 acceptance

cases.title: a missing part exits 2 with one JSON error that names the part
cases.when: drop each of --id, --round, --profile, --part for verify, and --id or --n for attempt; pass --ts for state
cases.then: exit 2 and an error that names the part; --ts exits 2
cases.actual: all hold
cases.specSource: R-009 and R-010 acceptance; tests.md T-R-009c and T-R-010c

evidence.title: one example
evidence.inline:
name --kind verify (no --profile)
-> exit 2 {"ok": false, "error": "a verify branch name needs a non-empty profile"}

cases.title: an explicit state ts is used as given, and empty or None generates one
cases.when: call name(fmt, 'state', ts=...) for '20261008101500', '', None, 0 and hostile values
cases.then: the explicit ts is used as given; empty and None give 14 digits
cases.actual: sdlc/state-20261008101500 and feature/PROJ-1-state-20261008101500; ts 0 gives sdlc/state-0; ts '../../x' is used as given
cases.specSource: R-008 acceptance

evidence.title: API results
evidence.inline:
ts 0 -> sdlc/state-0
ts '../../x' -> sdlc/state-../../x
ts 'a@{1} b\x01' -> used as given

seeds.title: S3: os reached through another module's attribute
seeds.detail: shutil.os.system(...) and os.path.os.system(...) qualify as shutil.os.system and os.path.os.system, so is_process misses them. The output equals the pins.

seeds.title: S3: JS Function reached through .constructor
seeds.detail: (() => 1).constructor('return pro' + 'cess') in sdlc-loop.js uses no banned identifier. jsHits stays empty.

seeds.title: S2: git --exec-path= before a pinned verb
seeds.detail: git(repo, '--exec-path=/tmp/x', 'fetch') keeps every pin. The option selects another git-fetch binary.

seeds.title: S5: skipped directory names match at every depth
seeds.detail: skills/sdlc/tracker/test/x.py is not scanned. A scanned script can import it.

seeds.title: String code execution outside DYNAMIC_NAMES
seeds.detail: cProfile.run, profile.run, timeit.timeit, pdb.run and trace run a code string. The scanner does not report them.

seeds.title: Browser script in tracker/template.html is not scanned
seeds.detail: A fetch POST in the .html template keeps every pin. The page holds no forge token today.

seeds.title: Hostile state ts is used as given
seeds.detail: name(fmt, 'state', ts='../../x') gives sdlc/state-../../x, and ts 0 gives sdlc/state-0. The name is not checked with git check-ref-format. Negative round, part and n were reported in earlier rounds.

seeds.title: testkit: pycall.py takes positional arguments only
seeds.detail: name(fmt, kind, **parts) and tail(kind, **parts) need keyword arguments. The test loads branches.py with its own script.
